Source: https://github.com/lvgl/lv_font_conv/tree/2107ab79b615a6ff7051796fa9f7ae52f042437b

compress.js is the unmodified MIT-licensed lib/font/compress.js. Used only by the offline font generator, preserving the existing Pillow glyph pixels and metrics. No npm dependencies. Native LVGL 9.5 validation passed for all 501 glyphs on 2026-10-05. The reviewed LVGL 9.6 decoder differs only by added non-NULL assertions; a separate 9.6 native build was not run for this change.
